name: WANTED: Incinerator Gar'im
summary: In Lakeshire, Magistrate Solomon offers a bounty for Incinerator Gar'im, whose forces threaten the town. The hostile orc commander holds Render's Valley with shadowcasters and is said to work with the Blackrock clan at Stonewatch Keep.

sections.title: A Fire in Render's Valley
sections.body: Blackrock orcs press out from their mountain strongholds, making the Redridge Mountains more dangerous. In Render's Valley, Gar'im leads an incursion with loyal shadowcasters and dark sorcery. Lakeshire's guard is stretched thin, and the crown's armies are largely absent. So Magistrate Solomon calls on independent fighters to eliminate Gar'im, who is said to work with the Blackrock at Stonewatch Keep.

sections.title: Proof of Demise
sections.body: Gar'im is known for destructive magic and command over shadow-weaving casters. To claim the township's reward, hunters enter enemy-held territory and defeat him. They must return his shattered staff to Lakeshire's town hall as proof that the threat has ended.

faq.answer: Incinerator Gar'im is an orc warlord and spellcaster leading an incursion in Render's Valley. He is said to work with the Blackrock orcs of Stonewatch Keep and commands dangerous shadowcasters.

faq.q: Where can Incinerator Gar'im be found?
faq.answer: Gar'im camps among hostile orc forces in Render's Valley, in the southeastern Redridge Mountains.

faq.q: Who posted the bounty for Gar'im?
faq.answer: Magistrate Solomon posts the bounty on Lakeshire's behalf, hoping to stem the orc incursions bearing down on the embattled town.

faq.q: What proof is required to claim the bounty?
faq.answer: Magistrate Solomon requires the Broken Staff of Incinerator Gar'im as proof of the spellcaster's death before paying the reward.

faq.q: What threat do Gar'im and his followers pose?
faq.answer: Gar'im wields lethal destructive magic and is flanked by shadowcasters. Together, they strengthen the Blackrock clan's hold in Redridge and threaten to overwhelm Lakeshire if left unchecked.

faq.q: Why is Lakeshire relying on bounties rather than the Stormwind army?
faq.answer: Stormwind has left Redridge largely to defend itself amid political strife and troop shortages. Magistrate Solomon has had to hire willing fighters to kill enemy leaders.

angles.text: As an Alliance fighter, you protect Lakeshire's vulnerable citizens from the leader of an orc incursion and his dangerous shadowcasters when you defeat Incinerator Gar'im.
As a mage, you face Gar'im and his shadowcasters, who wield a corrupted form of offensive arcana and shadow magic. Answer them swiftly with counter-spellcraft.
